title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1988-09-12
lineage: Sony TC-D5M (original record deck) > Pre Sonus Inspire GT > Sound Forge > .wav files > Trader's Little Helper > flac and ffp files
source: source: 2 Sennheiser KMF4's > Sony TC-D5M (10th row-center) - analog master cassettes - Maxell MX-90's

ai_review.summary: Mixed audience recording quality, yet the concert dazzles with a standout Jack Straw opener.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as an "amazing show" with a superb opening of Jack Straw, earning high marks for musical enjoyment. However, listeners are split on the audio: one celebrates the crisp Sennheiser mix while another condemns the audience capture as unusable, making the overall listening experience uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated very high (≈4.5) but recording quality ranges from excellent to terrible; combined weighted score yields ~3.8 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer praises a clear, "right there" Sennheiser mix, while another calls the audience capture poor and advises skipping it; overall audio is inconsistent.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure beyond noting a strong opening with Jack Straw.
